name: dark-warm-pink-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: mirror selfie, loungewear, and dim interior reference

prompt.project_info: Create a stylish mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a dim modern dressing room or bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural hair and soft neutral gaze, wearing a soft pink ribbed long-sleeve cardigan fully closed over a modest top and matching high-waisted lounge pants, with a matching scrunchie.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium waist-up vertical mirror selfie, one hand raised to hair, smartphone in the other, round gold-toned mirror, dark vanity, blurred washing machine/appliance, realistic reflection, no midriff exposure.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm side light, saturated pink and gold accents against a dark moody background, slight film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mobile photography, portrait 3:4, wide-angle mirror framing, natural skin texture, shallow background depth, accurate reflection.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman takes a warm pink mirror selfie in a dim modern dressing room, wearing a fully closed soft pink ribbed long-sleeve cardigan over a modest top and matching high-waisted lounge pants, with a scrunchie. Use a round gold mirror, dark vanity, blurred appliance, warm side light, saturated pink accents, realistic reflection, and slight film grain. No exposed midriff or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, exposed midriff, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, fake text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
